hint.label: Mongolia
text: Mongolia is a country in Asia that borders China and Russia.

atoms.text: As a little girl, Amira lived with her mother and other families in big tents in the countryside of Mongolia. Her mum took her on long hikes to show her the beautiful landscape of their country. They often walked for the whole day and only returned home late at night. Then, they would cook dinner together and share their favourite moments of the day with the other family members.

text: A falcon is a bird that is often used for hunting.
hint.label: Falcon

atoms.text: This is Amira today. Even as an adult, she still loves to spend as much time as possible outside. Her favorite activities are going on long walks and spending time with her family and friends. She is an excellent archer, a skilled hunter, and always brings her horse and falcon with her when she goes on a new adventure.
